WITH scan_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    sites.healtheval,
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin
  FROM scans s
  INNER JOIN sites ON s.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND s.zoneref IS NOT NULL
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    healtheval,
    AVG(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin != 0 THEN gbsize / spanmin END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as scan_count
  FROM scan_data
  GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  g.zoneref,
  g.healtheval,
  g.avg_ratio,
  g.scan_count,
  g.avg_ratio - o.mean_ratio as difference
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
WHERE g.avg_ratio > o.mean_ratio
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
